rationale: MISEV-aligned and mechanistically plausible; supported as an exploratory identity approach but key gaps remain (capture specificity vs co-isolates, buffer/reagent compatibility, low-biomass sensitivity, lot-to-lot reproducibility, and no demonstrated link to recoverable in vivo exposure). Proceed with the proposed orthogonal fractionation + capture + detergent/protease protection experiments (including apolipoprotein/negative controls, EM/cryo verification, buffer-compatibility panels, replicate lots, and short-interval in vivo recovery) to generate the evidence needed before any adoption as an identity gate.
